preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n - 1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
The given edges form a connected acyclic graph (a tree) on n vertices.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < 1000000007 for x in output_values)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid residue modulo 1000000007.
The k-th integer (0-indexed) equals the number of labeled trees on n vertices that share exactly k edges with the input tree, modulo 1000000007.
